summary.text: Amáda Márquez Simula is the Democratic candidate for Minnesota House of Representatives District 39B in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Republican Kt Jacobs in a race with no incumbent.
Her campaign website describes her as the mayor of Columbia Heights, serving her third term.

paragraphs.text: Amáda Márquez Simula's campaign website says she was born in Madison, Wisconsin, to a working-class family, and that her father was a childhood immigrant from Mexico.
The site says she and her brothers turned a fledgling restaurant into one of the most successful venues in the area.
It describes her as the first person of color elected to office in Columbia Heights and the second Latina mayor in Minnesota's history.
Márquez Simula defeated Justice Spriggs in the August 11, 2026 Democratic primary, 4,439 votes to 2,133, according to Ballotpedia.

Her campaign website says she is the DFL-endorsed candidate and lists healthcare, housing, school funding, clean water and climate action, and constitutional equality protections among her priorities.
